items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Who did you play with up in Milwaukee? I played with a fellow lived up in Milwaukee, Doc Holley... And I played with him, uh, about a year or more.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with him?

Well, I'd sit in, I'd sit in with him, go down to the Dreamland there. And, uh, I could never, never do much, but, like, of course I wasn't, uh, couldn't, uh, have them grab those ideas, you know. Yeah, it's hard to learn right away. Yeah, uh-huh. Something new. Yeah, uh-huh. But, uh, I have, I've played, played in, and here, here, when I, I went to play in Milwaukee for, oh, for about a year, left Chicago, and went up there for a year, a couple years. And that's before he enlarged his band, he, and he, yeah, he,…
I knew you said. Who else was in the band then?
